scripts.android: export CAP_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=${CAP_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY:-$(sed -n 's/^NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=//p' ../../../web/surfaces/app/.env.local)} && export CAP_SERVER_URL=${CAP_SERVER_URL:-http://localhost:3002} && pnpm www && cap sync android && pnpm android:run
scripts.android:run: cd android && ./gradlew -q installDebug && for p in 3000 3002 8787; do adb reverse tcp:$p tcp:$p; done && adb shell am start -n $(node -p "require('../shell.json').appId")/.MainActivity
scripts.ios: export CAP_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=${CAP_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY:-$(sed -n 's/^NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=//p' ../../../web/surfaces/app/.env.local)} && export CAP_SERVER_URL=${CAP_SERVER_URL:-http://localhost:3002} && pnpm www && cap run ios
